thread:
ciara: paging — error rate spike for aurora-13b (hosted). 5xxs up to 8% on /v1/generate, latency p95 jumping to 1.5s. Customer-facing errors reported from a handful of high-volume tenants. @oncall-bot triggered page at 1726004300 :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — High error rate detected for model_family=aurora-13b (hosted). Severity: P2. Runbook: model-rate-mitigation. Pager: eng-runtime oncall.

alex: on it. I can see a surge of long-context requests and heavy streaming usage from a few API keys. Traffic concentrated in us-west1.

ciara: thanks alex. Can you confirm if KV cache pressure or batching stalls are the cause? p95 memory usage spiking on a subset of pods.

alex: checking logs now — a lot of requests with seq_len > 1024 and funcall enabled. We have known perf cliff with aurora-13b + funcall under long contexts.

maya: product-ops, tagging the affected customers — @product-ops can you surface any active campaigns that might explain the spike?

product-ops: seeing 2 enterprise tenants with heavy scheduled jobs (dialog exports). Notified account reps. No planned deploys.

seb: propose immediate live mitigations: 1) temporarily lower hosted TPM for aurora-13b; 2) disable function-calling (funcall) for aurora-13b on hosted tier; 3) apply short prefix-cache TTL change. One or two of these should reduce downstream pressure quickly.

ciara: agreed. Prioritize minimal customer disruption. Start with funcall toggle to preserve throughput for non-funcall traffic. If that fails, lower TPM for hosted.

alex: prepping commands. Will execute in two steps with short observation windows.

alex: === EXECUTE ===

```
# toggle funcall off for hosted aurora family
rdmctl feature-toggle set --model-family aurora-13b --feature funcall --state off --scope hosted
# reduce per-key TPM soft limit (temporary)
rdmctl quota update --model-family aurora-13b --scope hosted --tpm 650
```

seb: will monitor. Setting a 5m watch and ramp-down safety checks. If errors reduce and latency stabilizes, we keep TTL for 15m then reassess.

ops-notify-bot: NOTIFICATION: funcall disabled for model_family=aurora-13b (hosted) at 1726004450 by alex.

ciara: immediate signal — error rate dropped from 8% -> 2.1% in 2m, p95 latency down to 900ms. Good. Keep observing for jitter.

maya: heads-up to reps: customers see transient funcall failures; they may get structured responses instead. Chatted with one rep, they prefer temporary errors over timeouts.

alex: moving to quotas now — reducing TPM applied. Will keep a staging candidate and hit the route controller.

alex: === EXECUTE ===

```
rdmctl quota update --model-family aurora-13b --scope hosted --tpm 500 --note "temp emergency mitigation 172600"
```

seb: tracking - applied. If throughput bottleneck persists, we may need to carve higher priority for dedicated/reserved customers and add a routing rule.

ciara: add a quick routing fallback to route traffic from high-error keys to aurora-13b-quant (quantized variant) if compatible. Lower quality but more stable.

alex: adding route rule now.

alex: === EXECUTE ===

```
rdmctl routing add --from model=aurora-13b --to model=aurora-13b-quant --criteria "tenant in [\"acct-A\",\"acct-B\"]" --priority 110
```

ops-notify-bot: ROUTE CHANGE: fallback routing created for 2 tenants at 1726004580 by alex.

ciara: monitoring — overall error rate now 0.9%, p95 650ms. Dedicated customers unaffected. Good signal.

maya: logging customer impact: 2 tenants routed to quant variant, funcall disabled for hosted. Messaging to accounts: brief outage to funcall; degraded outputs on fallback.

seb: creating a short on-call handoff note for SRE rotation. We should schedule follow-up: root cause analysis (model-config + long-context funcall combo), consider a permanent guardrail to auto-disable funcall when seq_len > 1024 for aurora family.

ciara: +1. Also request model team to evaluate a performance patch or improved attention kernels for long contexts. Tagging @model-team in follow-up doc.

product-ops: will draft customer comms and coordinate with account reps.

seb: summary for handoff: mitigations applied — funcall disabled (hosted), hosted TPM lowered to 500, two high-volume tenants routed to quant fallback. Monitoring is green (error rate <1%). Next actions: RCA ticket, alert tuning (add sequence-length anomaly alert), and rollback checklist to re-enable funcall after fix.

ciara: handing off to overnight on-call. Leaving runbook steps in the incident doc and the redeploy/rollback commands. If any regression, escalate to oncall pagers with severity bump.

oncall-bot: HANDOFF: incident P2 — aurora-13b hosted mitigation handed to next oncall at 1726004785. Handoff owner: seb.

seb: acknowledged. I have the runbook and will watch the dashboard until stable.

ciara: closing thread here — great coordination. Follow-up tasks assigned in the incident tracker: INC-2026-1726.

ops-notify-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied and incident reduced to monitoring at 1726004789.
